QuestInfo.name: Rue Ore's Secret
QuestInfo.0: Claudine the doctor of Edelstein is researching the Rue Ores. Go listen to what she has to say.
QuestInfo.1: Claudine believes that the #o2600414# are mutations caused by the Rue. She needs more #r#t4009041##k to continue with her research.
QuestInfo.2: You have gathered the #r#t4009041##k of #o2600414# so that Claudine can continue her research.

0.0: Have you ever heard about the Rue? Rue is a special ore found in Edelstein. It's carries with it about 100 times more energy then any other fuel sources. It is expensive so it is the main source of income for Edelstein.
0.1: But there is no one who know what the Rue is made of or how it is made. The Rue is known to affect people too. That is precisely the reason why I am researching it. Aren't you curious to know what secrets are hidden in those mines?

yes.0: I found a mutant born from #o2600414# after being affected by the rue while I was investigating the effects the Rue was having on living things. I will need #r15#k #r#t4009041##k to do some serious testing.

no.0: If the Rue is harming people then safety of everyone in Edelstein is at stake.

1.0: This an antennae of #o2600414#. Even the antennae is massive. Okay, now lets research how the Rue effects the gene.

default.0: Please bring me #r15#k #r#t4009041##k and I might be able to find the effects of Rue on living things.
